positive.finding: Storage-neutral CQ3_0x8 was bit-correct and accelerated the frozen two-matrix primitive by 1.3018x over ordinary CQ3.

negative.finding: CQ3_0x16 was stable but reached only 1.0667x over x8 and 1.3865x over ordinary CQ3, missing both frozen speed gates. More row widening is not the selected lane.

hypothesis: The x8 kernel repeats construction of the same four activation broadcasts for every eight output rows. Repacking weights block-group-panel-major lets a 256-row panel keep only a 1,024-byte INT32 accumulator in L1 while each activation quartet is broadcast once per panel and each 1,024-byte weight chunk is streamed contiguously. This removes most redundant activation setup without widening the live AVX2 accumulator set or changing arithmetic.

runtime_layout.order: block, group, 256-row panel, FP16 scale plane, then eight contiguous four-byte-per-row code planes
runtime_layout.aligned_scope: The native candidate handles row counts divisible by 256. A later graph integration must retain CQ3_0x8 for smaller or ragged tails.

static_cost_model.candidate_panel_working_set_note: The hot scratch, one code chunk, scales, and one output panel remain small relative to the 32 KiB L1 data cache; packed weights are consumed exactly once.

arithmetic_contract.block_group_order: block 0 group 0, block 0 group 1, then increasing blocks, identical to x8
arithmetic_contract.fp_accumulation_order: one FMA per block-group in the identical x8 order, with FP32 output reloaded from the panel between block-groups

measurement.schedule: Adjacent AB/BA pairs; even indices run control then candidate and odd indices run candidate then control. Comparison-family order alternates every two indices.
measurement.frequency_telemetry: Sample processor-0 MHz before and after every adjacent pair, using sysfs when present and /proc/cpuinfo on this KVM host.

gate_2_graph_integration.required_future_scope: Integrate only tensors with row counts divisible by 256, preserve x8 tails, and measure paired single-token decode before multi-column work.

gate_3_quality.reason: The candidate is a lossless repack with bit-identical x8 arithmetic. Capability gates attach to a separately admitted whole-model representation.

stop_rules: Stop before timing on any byte mapping, storage, integer-dot, x8 bit identity, finiteness, or numerical-bound failure.
Classify CPU affinity, host-idle, telemetry, execution, or receipt-capture faults as infrastructure invalid rather than zero performance.
Reject if either paired median misses its frozen threshold or either paired-ratio MAD fraction exceeds 0.03.
Do not tune the 256-row panel, layout order, thresholds, pair count, cache eviction, or arithmetic after observing candidate timing.
Do not run model or capability evaluation in this primitive experiment, and do not infer scores for unrun gates.
claim_boundary: A pass would establish a faster storage-neutral activation-stationary CQ3 single-token primitive and admit separate graph integration. It would not establish complete-model throughput, target-floor performance, quality, energy, novelty, 100 accepted tokens per second, or a scientific breakthrough.
